plugins.name: runbook-task-cycle
plugins.description: One coding task end to end: a coder, the project's checks, two independent reviews by different models, triage, fix rounds with verification, a polish pass. Every step is a throng thronglet; a project adapts it with one profile file.

plugins.name: agent-runbook-authoring
plugins.description: Writes runbooks: procedures an agent session runs through subagents. The steps are prompt files, the transitions are a few lines of Python on a small engine, and the orchestrator never reasons about what comes next.

plugins.name: consensus
plugins.description: Think a question through with a second model: both form positions independently, then reconcile round by round until they agree or the crux is clear. Needs the throng MCP server.
